summary: Iteration 228 - Batch 16 (Open Pricing per Channel + Yield Rules Engine) tested. Backend: 16/16 tests passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified. Channel Revenue Panel accessible via sidebar '⚡ Açık Fiyat + Yield' (data-testid='channel-revenue-btn'). 6 channel cards displayed with correct multipliers (direct=1.0, booking.com=1.18, expedia=1.20, corporate=0.85). Quote playground shows BAR, multiplier, per-night rate, total, occupancy%, and rules_applied[] with rate_before→rate_after transparency. 4 default yield rules seeded (Yüksek doluluk +20%, Hafta sonu primi +15%, Last-minute -10%, OTA kanal +5%). Rule editor modal has name, priority, triggers (occupancy, days-to-arrival, DOW buttons), and actions. Regression tests passed for Batch 13-15 (TR Compliance, AI Predictions, EU Compliance).
critical_code_review_comments: Channel configs auto-seed 6 defaults on first GET: direct(1.0), booking.com(1.18), expedia(1.20), airbnb(1.15), corporate(0.85), agent(0.88)
Each channel has base_multiplier, min_floor_pct, max_ceiling_pct for rate clamping
Quote pipeline: BAR → channel multiplier → yield rules (priority desc) → floor/ceiling clamp
rules_applied[] shows each rule's rate_before and rate_after for full transparency (Duetto-level explainability)
Yield rules support triggers: occupancy_gte/lte, days_to_arrival_lte/gte, dow_in[], channel_in[]
Yield rules support actions: rate_delta_pct, rate_delta_abs, min_los, cta_enabled, stop_sell
seed-defaults is idempotent - returns seeded=0 with note if rules already exist
Weekend rule (Hafta sonu primi) triggers on fri/sat with +15% rate delta
Amber color theme distinguishes from violet (AI Predictions) / sky (EU) / rose (TR)
